game_design.json.title: Whispering Woods
game_design.json.premise: A tranquil journey through a peaceful forest filled with glowing crystals and gentle breezes. No dangers await, allowing for a relaxing exploration.
design_notes: Enemies and hazards have been entirely excluded to ensure a peaceful experience.
Crystals serve as the primary collectible objective across all meadow and ruin sections.
Checkpoints are placed liberally to maintain the relaxed atmosphere.
